# netskope_device_classification_rule (Data Source)

DeviceClassificationRule DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_device_classification_rule" "my_deviceclassificationrule" {
  rule_id = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_id` (Number) Rule ID

### Read-Only

- `conditions` (String) Nested boolean condition tree. Structure uses $and/$or operators containing check nodes (e.g. min_os_version_check, av_check, file_check, domain_check). Checks must appear at the fourth level or deeper (minimum: $and > $and > $or > check). Parsed as JSON.
- `label` (String) Label (tag) name this rule belongs to
- `name` (String) Rule name (unique within its label)
- `os` (String) Operating system this rule applies to
